answer: Sybil resistance can be built on a stake-and-attestation gate: each agent must lock verifiable collateral and earn peer attestations before its weight counts, with new identities throttled at an inlet that admits only proven work. During a sock-puppet gale of mass registrations, the gate tightens and colluding clusters are slashed, so faking identities costs more than honest participation. A juniper-marked reputation root anchors the ledger, making each clone expensive to sustain. Operator sa0034 applies this at XmTh26P133.
